privacy.intro: AUDITAXES Global protects the confidentiality of information people share when using this site or communicating with our network.

sections.title: Information we may receive
sections.body: We may receive identification and contact details, along with information voluntarily included in an inquiry. This site does not request financial data or access credentials.

sections.title: Purposes
sections.body: We use information to answer requests, route inquiries to the appropriate firm, maintain professional communications and improve the website experience.

sections.title: Retention and security
sections.body: We keep information only as long as necessary for the relevant purpose and apply reasonable measures to prevent unauthorized access, use or disclosure.

sections.title: Rights and contact
sections.body: You may request access, correction or deletion of your data by writing to info@audit-taxes.com.mx. The responsible firm will confirm the applicable process for your jurisdiction.

terms.intro: These terms govern access to and informational use of the AUDITAXES Global website.

sections.title: Scope of content
sections.body: Published information is general in nature and does not constitute accounting, tax, legal or financial advice for a specific case.

sections.title: Professional relationship
sections.body: Submitting an inquiry does not create a professional relationship. Every service requires express acceptance, a defined scope and the corresponding agreements.

sections.title: Accuracy and availability
sections.body: We aim to keep content current, but rules and circumstances may change. The site may be modified, suspended or updated without prior notice.

sections.title: Intellectual property
sections.body: The trademarks, text, graphics and materials on this site belong to their respective owners and may not be used without authorization, except as permitted by law.

ethics.intro: Trust requires independence, integrity and accountability in every professional relationship.

sections.title: Principles
sections.body: Network firms promote objectivity, professional competence, confidentiality and compliance with the rules applicable in each market.

sections.title: Conflicts of interest
sections.body: Before accepting an engagement, independence conditions and potential conflicts are evaluated and appropriate safeguards are applied.

sections.title: Confidentiality
sections.body: Client and third-party information is used only for authorized purposes and protected according to professional and legal obligations.

sections.title: Responsible reporting
sections.body: Any concern regarding professional conduct or compliance may be reported in good faith to info@audit-taxes.com.mx for confidential routing.
